plan.goal: Create an Accel/Speed/Brake Graph Panel in RViz

topic.name: /vehicle/status/velocity_status
topic.description: Used to plot the speed of the vehicle.

topic.name: /control/command/actuation_cmd
topic.description: Used to plot the acceleration and braking commands.

step.name: Create Header File
step.description: Declare the GraphPanel class inheriting from rviz_common::Panel. Add Qt macro Q_OBJECT. Declare ROS 2 node, subscriptions, and QChart/QLineSeries pointers.

step.name: Create Source File
step.description: Implement the constructor to set up QChartView and add it to a QVBoxLayout. Override onInitialize() to get the rviz_common::DisplayContext's ROS node and initialize subscriptions.

step.name: Implement Data Handling
step.description: In the subscription callbacks, append the new values (speed, accel, brake) with timestamps to their respective QLineSeries. Ensure the x-axis scrolls or scales dynamically with time.

step.name: Update CMakeLists.txt
step.description: Add graph_panel.hpp to headers_to_moc, add graph_panel.cpp to display_source_files, and link Qt5::Charts.

step.name: Update Plugins Description
step.description: Add the new GraphPanel class to allow RViz to discover it.
